name: kyde-score-cowork
description: Kyde Score for Claude Desktop / Cowork tasks: reports each tool call (tool name, success, duration, session; never content) to score.kyde.com, warns the agent when its behavior deviates from its baseline, holds a call outside the human-confirmed contract (Pro and up), and answers 'How is my Kyde score?'.

kyde_key.title: Kyde key
kyde_key.description: Your scoring key (kyde_...). Leave empty and ask Claude to 'set up Kyde' to create one.

agent_name.title: Agent name
agent_name.description: Name of this agent in the Kyde dashboard. Cowork tasks run on a new cloud machine each time, so the name must not depend on the machine.
